src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            comp = []
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            touches_edge = False
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                if y == 0 or y == h - 1 or x == 0 or x == w - 1:
                    touches_edge = True
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            if not touches_edge:
                ys = [y for y, x in comp]
                xs = [x for y, x in comp]
                ih = max(ys) - min(ys) + 1
                iw = max(xs) - min(xs) + 1
                fill = 2 if ih % 2 == 0 and iw % 2 == 0 else 7
                for y, x in comp:
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
